is: A form of the verb be when talking about someone or something else.
island: An island is a piece of ground that is completely surrounded by water.
The fisherman lived alone on a small island in .
An island of an object, person, or place, is one surrounded by things very different from itself.
An island of peace and silence in a noisy city.
issue: An issue is a particular topic or subject, often one that people are discussing and/or is a problem.
The students raised an important issue in my last class, and I hope we can discuss it today.
An issue of a magazine, newspaper, etc. is the version that is published at one time.
The March issue of The Walrus has an interesting article on healthcare.
If you issue something, such as a statement, guidelines or an order, you officially publish it.
The governments of Canada and the United States jointly issued a statement about the recent crash.
isolate: If you isolate something, you make it so that it does not or cannot contact certain other things.
We want to isolate ourselves from everyday worries.
An isolate is something that does not or cannot contact certain other things.
A total of 296 isolates were recovered from 105 patients, 79 (75%) of whom were infected with mycobacteria.
An isolate is a language that has no known relatives.
isolated: If you isolate something, you make it so that it does not or cannot contact certain other things.
We went to isolate ourselves from everyday worries.
If something is isolated it is alone.
As she got older and her friends moved away, she became more and more isolated.
islam: Islam is a religion that teaches there is only one God, that Muhammad is his prophet, and that the Koran is God's scripture.
There is a close historical relationship between Christianity and Islam.
isotope: ; Isotopes are atomic cores belonging to the same element that have the same number of protons, but have a different number of neutrons.
Uranium 235 and uranium 238 are isotopes of uranium.
istanbul: Istanbul is the largest city in Turkey.
israel: Israel is a country in the Middle East.
Israel is the only Jewish country in the world.
Israel was an ancient kingdom in the Middle East.
isolation: When something is isolated, not together with others, apart, alone, or separated.
Some people in Tibet live in isolation because of the large mountain ranges.
When a country chooses not to trade or relate with other countries.
The isolation of North Korea is a common topic in politics.
israeli: A person who lives (or grew up) in Israel.
Something or someone that is Israeli comes from Israel.
israelite: Israelite is a person who lived in ancient kingdom of Israel.
islamophobically: When something is done Islamophobically, it is done with hatred against Islam and Muslims.
islamophobic: If someone is Islamophobic, that person has a fear and hatred against Islam and Muslims.
islamophobia: Islamophobia is a fear or dislike of Islam and Muslims.
islamophobe: An Islamophobe is a person who fears or dislikes Muslims.
islet: A islet is a small island.
isoelectric: If something is isoelectric, it means that it has no electric charge or difference in electronic potential.
islamic: If something is Islamic, it is related to Muslims or Islam.
islander: An islander is a person who lives on an island.
isthmus: An isthmus is a narrow piece of land that connects two larger pieces of land.
